description: Implementation -> explicit human UX approval -> author consolidated People connector selection/routing browser scenarios, reusing test/e2e/specs/people.spec.js. Until approval do not author new E2E; LiveView/integration immediate tests required. Final review, coverage handoff and precommit before final approval.

comments.text: During the four ownership-review corrections, human approved replacing provider/retrieval/topic native selectors with shared ZaqWeb.Select rule inputs. This is component-reuse approval, not final overall UX approval. Ran existing test/e2e/specs/people.spec.js on Chromium in isolated _c_e2e1: 23 passed, 6 failed. Five failures (merge channel flow and email/telegram duplicate add/edit same/cross person flows) submit channels without required connector selection; Telegram fixture has no configured connector. One dropdown assertion expects lowercase telegram/discord, while ProviderCatalog correctly renders Telegram/Discord. Error snapshots confirm required connector errors. No assertions weakened, no new E2E authored. Minimal fixture/selector repair and existing-browser revalidation remain pending; final precommit/approval remains blocked along with four historical NormalizePersonEmails replay failures.

User approved minimal repairs to outdated People E2E scenarios and retirement/consolidation of four obsolete NormalizePersonEmails replay cases. Removed the automatic graph/lowest-ID replay property and the two profile-only-email replay variants; current explicit group/chain merge test now checks connector/native identity IDs, metadata, preference weight, activity timestamp, normalized matching and repeat discovery without extra links. Moved blank-name history labels to a direct current merge test. Remaining existing normalization tests unchanged. For browser prerequisites, reuse disabled sender/default resolution and ChannelConfig.upsert_by_provider through an E2E-only fixture endpoint (test/support handler; route inside existing compile-time E2E gate). Fixture response contains IDs only; no production behavior or tool exposure. Reuse/reset existing describe-level fixture pattern and shared BO helpers; seed via API rather than navigate unrelated admin pages. Preserve all duplicate/merge assertions, select explicit scoped connectors, and update friendly labels while checking platform values. First isolated unit run: 50 tests +4 properties passed.

Existing People E2E repairs validated on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit: 87/87 passed on isolated _c_e2e2. Required connector selection is explicit in all existing add flows; Telegram prerequisite is seeded through the E2E-only API, with no global-reset fixture pollution or active listener. Platform dropdown assertions check friendly labels AND canonical values. Detail channel badges remain lowercase, so original merge assertions are unchanged. Relevant merge/email/scoping unit tests: 50 tests +4 properties passed. The four obsolete replay cases were removed as approved; business identity/preference/history guarantees now exercise current merge APIs. Remaining working older migration tests and migrations themselves are untouched. Action reuse: fixture-only helpers reuse existing config selection/upsert APIs and shared test support; no new production domain operation/Action/tool. Follow-up is test/fixture-only (route inside existing E2E compile guard), so no new production coverage target; overall PR coverage and final UX review remain separate. Running full precommit readiness gate next.

Requested existing-test follow-up complete: mix q passed; isolated merge/email/scoping validation passed 50 tests +4 properties; People E2E passed all 87 existing cases across Chromium/Firefox/WebKit. Full mix precommit rerun passed 48 doctests, 240 properties, 10657 tests, zero failures (1 skipped, 122 excluded) on _c_ff1. First full run encountered one unrelated PortalConsentLiveTest 100ms render_async timeout; its 7 isolated tests passed, and the full gate rerun passed without modifying that module. No skip/timeout changes or assertion weakening. Existing six E2E mismatches and four obsolete replay failures are cleared. Remaining working normalization tests and consumed migration files unchanged. Changes confined to current merge assertions, retired four obsolete replay cases, People spec/support fixtures and one route inside the existing E2E compile guard. Follow-up changes remain uncommitted/unpushed. Overall new-feature UX/E2E/coverage approval scope remains separate.

At user request, committed and pushed the validated test follow-up as d8f191f38 (test(people): update connector journeys and current merge coverage) to origin/feature/issue-768-history-b-execution. Commit qf/message hooks and push format hook passed; working tree clean. No PR merge performed.
